name: @nohotfix/e2e-cypress-live
description: Env-driven live E2E harness: runs the cypress-reporter against a real NoHotfix API. Invoked explicitly by the nohotfix.com CI workflow (needs the Cypress binary + a browser), skipped unless NHF_E2E_CI_KEY is set. Exposes an `e2e` script (not `test`) so the repo's unit CI never boots Electron.
